newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares soar 9.60 pct to three-yr high.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares soar 9.60 pct to three-yr high.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index soared in heavy trading on Monday, with more Chinese investors rushing into the market, attracted by its recent rises, brokers said.

The B index surged 17.35 points, or 9.60 percent, to end at 198.14, its highest closing level since November 1993, brokers said. The index hit an intra-session high of 198.52 and turnover rose to HK$779.22 million, also the highest since late 1993, from HK$656.76 million on Friday.
Trading has become increasingly speculative and will become more volatile in the coming sessions, brokers said.
"The market's sharp gains over the past month have been attracting more and more investors, especially mainland Chinese," said a broker at China Southern Securities.
"Securities regulators may act to cool the excessively bullish sentiment, such as tightening controls on buying by domestic investors," he said.
"We see resistance at the 200-point level, which would be a psychological barrier," said one analyst.
Shenzhen-based counters were among the session's top gainers.
Watch maker Fiyta surged HK$1.41, or 22.07 percent, to HK$7.80, on volume of 1.39 million shares.
Conglomerate Zhonghao soared HK$1.30, or 21.04 percent, to HK$7.48 on trade of 988,360 shares due to speculative buying.
Gujing Distillery rose HK$2.00, or 20 percent, to HK$12.00, with 1.49 million shares changing hands.
Changan Automobile traded the most on volume of 13.71 million shares and put on HK$0.45 to HK$6.35 on heavy speculative demand by institutions, brokers said.
Lizhu Pharmaceutical advanced HK$0.56 to HK$6.44 on the session's second heaviest volume of 8.02 million shares.

The A share index rose 10.52 points, or 2.19 percent, to finish at a record closing high of 491.04 on turnover of 15 billion yuan, up from 14.78 billion in the previous session. The composite index added 11.62 points, or 2.55 percent, to 467.78.
Brokers said they expect the A share advance to continue in the absence of negative news.
Guangzhou-based Nanhuaxi Industrial Co Ltd, which listed 11.25 million A shares in Shenzhen on Monday, ended at 25.45 yuan against a recent offer price of 8.38 yuan a share.
Air-conditioner maker Zhuhai Gree surged 9.90 yuan to 59.40 yuan. Huatian Hotel fell one yuan to 25.50 yuan.
